define_common_args: define common CLI arguments for data loading, 3D representation, rendering, display, and optimizer options on a configargparse parser
build_data_options: build a dictionary of data loading options from parsed CLI args to pass as kwargs to the dataset constructor
maybe_merge_config_file: load a JSON config file and merge its key-value pairs into parsed CLI args, validating against known arguments
setup_render_opts: pass rendering arguments from CLI args to a SparseGrid renderer options object for 3D scene rendering
review_config_util: review the config utility module that defines common arguments, builds data options, merges config files, and sets up render options
